definitions: A refrigeration system designed to prevent the accumulation of frost or ice inside the freezer or refrigerator compartment.
A feature in refrigerators and freezers that automatically defrosts the evaporator, eliminating the need for manual defrosting.
examples: The new refrigerator boasts a No Frost feature.
We prefer a No Frost freezer for convenience.
No Frost technology has become standard in modern appliances.
